newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest spot prods notionally unchanged.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest spot prods notionally unchanged.

text.p: Idle California markets and higher products futures kept Northwest products prices notionally unchanged in thin Friday trade.
California conventional regular gasoline were notionally flat at 64/64.50 cents for November parcels, with October parcels unchanged at 62/63 cents a gallon.
Regular unleaded gasoline was assessed notionally at 62.50 cents to 63.50 cent a gallon, flat from Thursday.
In Seattle, low-sulphur diesel stayed 75/76 cents and jet fuel remained 76.50/77.50 cents a gallon.
